raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Use `draft_sample_method: probabilistic` in the Kimi-K3 GB300 TP8/TP16 low-latency guide script, matching the aggregated configurations in [InferenceX #4047](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4047).

## Claims

- Corrects the documented draft sampling method for both aggregated presets while retaining `rejection_sample_method: block`.

## Validation

- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <vllm-checkout>/recipes`: passed schema validation, strict assembly and JSON API generation.
- `pre-commit run --files recipes/models/moonshotai/Kimi-K3.yaml` and `git diff --check`: passed.
- Extracted the guide script, checked it with `bash -n`, and captured its arguments using a stub `vllm` executable: TP8 and TP16, head and follower, emit valid speculative JSON with probabilistic sampling and block rejection.
- Existing serving/evaluation evidence: [public InferenceX run 39140771499](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39140771499). No new GPU evaluation was run for this documentation correction.

## Details

The guide script still selects greedy draft sampling, whereas the referenced aggregated configurations use probabilistic sampling. The sampling method is part of the speculative-decoding configuration, so the example should state the intended method explicitly. The change is limited to that script setting. Searches of open Kimi-K3 recipe/sampling PRs found no existing PR addressing this correction; merged PRs #62528 and #62563 cover disaggregated guidance and selector settings.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

将 Kimi-K3 GB300 TP8/TP16 低延迟部署指南脚本中的 `draft_sample_method` 从 `greedy` 改为 `probabilistic`，与公开的 [InferenceX #4047](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4047) 聚合式配置一致，保留 `rejection_sample_method: block`。

配方 schema 校验、严格组装、JSON API 生成、pre-commit 检查及 Bash 语法检查均已通过。使用替代 `vllm` 命令捕获 TP8/TP16 主节点和从节点的参数，确认生成的投机解码 JSON 正确。本次文档修正未运行新的 GPU 评测，现有公开验证链接见上文。检索未发现处理同一修正的开放 PR；已合并的 #62528 和 #62563 涉及分离式部署指南及选择器配置。

</details>

<details>
<summary>AI assistance</summary>

Prepared with OpenAI Codex (GPT-6; exact deployed model version is not exposed). AI assisted with the one-line edit, local validation and PR text, following the human-requested correction.

使用 OpenAI Codex（GPT-6，运行环境未提供确切部署版本）辅助完成经用户指定的单行修改、本地校验及 PR 文本。

</details>

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>
